responsibility: Exercises the `base_n` numeric encoding API by verifying that `to_base` and `to_base_fixed_len` produce strings that round-trip through standard radix parsing across supported bases and integer boundary values, including maximum-width integers.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the crate’s many collection, graph, and hashing test files, this one is a tiny codec round-trip suite for base-N integer encoding: it only checks that `encode` output parses back correctly across radices and large integer values.
